items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: No direct interaction between Maxine Sullivan and Canada Lee is mentioned in the transcript.

ctx.x: Right. When it was originally written, it was called 'Let's Begin Again.' It was one of those BMI tunes that were written during the ASCAP-BMI situation.

And, of course, under the music, there was commentary there. Originally when we did the show, Canada Lee did the commentary. And on that particular album on this particular date, Canada Lee was no longer with us either.
And Jack Walker did the commentary.
